This phase II trial focuses on patients with histologically confirmed renal cell carcinoma, testing the efficacy of axitinib, bevacizumab, everolimus, sorafenib, and sunitinib as targeted therapies, with specific eligibility criteria including prior treatment history and organ function assessments.

This study in phase II focuses on chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma and involves drugs like bendamustine hydrochloride, lenalidomide, and rituximab, with inclusion criteria including histologically confirmed disease and specific laboratory values, and exclusion criteria such as serious medical conditions or concurrent use of other anti-cancer agents.

This trial in phase II focuses on patients with colorectal neoplasms and involves the drug panitumumab, targeting those with histologically proven adenocarcinoma of the rectum and wild-type KRAS, with specific inclusion and exclusion criteria, and relevant ICD-10 codes.

This trial in phase II focuses on individuals with alcohol-related disorders and substance-related disorders, using drugs like aprepitant and fosaprepitant, with strict inclusion and exclusion criteria including drug use history, psychiatric disorders, and medical conditions, aiming to study the effects on mental health and addiction treatment.

This trial is investigating the use of pembrolizumab, an immune checkpoint inhibitor, in patients with advanced solid tumors, including head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, who have shown resistance to previous treatments, with specific eligibility criteria related to age, tumor characteristics, and prior therapies.

Phase 2 trial for patients with core-binding factor acute myeloid leukemia (AML) testing the drugs cytarabine, dasatinib, and daunorubicin, with eligibility criteria including documentation of disease by molecular diagnosis, no prior chemotherapy for leukemia, and specific cardiac and pregnancy requirements, and associated with ICD-10 codes related to leukemia and myeloid diseases.

This trial in phase II focuses on the treatment of recurrent or metastatic squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck using drugs like carboplatin, cetuximab, and paclitaxel, with specific inclusion and exclusion criteria, targeting neoplasms, particularly squamous cell carcinoma, with associated ICD-10 codes.

This study in phase II focuses on patients with newly diagnosed grade IV malignant glioma, testing the drugs levodopa and temozolomide, with inclusion criteria including planned radiation treatments at Mayo Clinic and specific eligibility criteria related to renal function, performance status, and medication restrictions.

This phase II trial is investigating the efficacy of capecitabine and docetaxel in patients with locally advanced or metastatic adenocarcinoma of gastric, gastro-esophageal, or esophageal origin, with specific eligibility criteria and exclusion criteria outlined.

This phase II trial focuses on evaluating the efficacy of pemetrexed and sorafenib in treating unresectable triple negative breast neoplasms, with inclusion criteria including prior treatment for recurrent or metastatic disease, specific tumor staining requirements, and various health parameters, while excluding patients with certain medical conditions or recent anticancer therapies.

This study in PHASE2 focuses on evaluating the efficacy of pimecrolimus in treating dry eye syndromes, with inclusion criteria such as history of artificial tear use and moderate to severe signs of dry eye, and exclusion criteria including uncontrolled systemic or ocular diseases, refractive surgery history, and use of other topical ocular medications. This study in phase II focuses on type 1 diabetes mellitus patients using insulin glargine, with inclusion criteria such as HbA1c levels, BMI range, insulin administration capability, and exclusion criteria including recent insulin use, severe hypoglycemia episodes, and various medical conditions, targeting diseases related to glucose metabolism disorders and autoimmune diseases, with the drug insulin glargine and associated ICD-10 codes.

This study in phase II focuses on the use of duloxetine hydrochloride for major depressive disorder (MDD) with specific inclusion and exclusion criteria, targeting patients with mood disorders and depressive disorders, as indicated by the listed ICD-10 codes.

This phase II trial focuses on patients with histologically confirmed gastric adenocarcinoma, testing the drugs irinotecan and oxaliplatin for recurrent or metastatic disease, with specific eligibility criteria including no prior treatment for recurrent or metastatic disease and adequate major organ function, while excluding patients with prior history of peripheral neuropathy or inadequate cardiovascular function.
